prompt: Some people say that living in a high-rise apartment block is a lonely experience because there is no community spirit. Others say that people who live in high-rise apartments have a much better sense of community than those who live in a house. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your knowledge or experience.
essay:
People have different views about living in high-rise apartment buildings. While some people believe that this can be a lonely experience, others argue that it can create a strong sense of community. In my opinion, living in a high-rise apartment can be either social or lonely depending on how people interact with their neighbours.

‏On the one hand, some people believe that living in high-rise buildings can be lonely. This is because residents may have little interaction with their neighbours. Although many people live in the same building, they may not know each other well. For example, people living on different floors might only see each other in the elevator without having a real conversation. In addition, some residents may prefer to keep their lives private, which can make it difficult to build relationships with others.

‏On the other hand, high-rise apartments can also provide a strong sense of community. One reason is that residents live close to many other people, so they have more opportunities to meet and communicate with their neighbours. For instance, people may regularly meet in shared areas such as the entrance, parking area, gym or garden. Moreover, residents can help each other with simple things, such as collecting packages or looking after each other’s homes while they are away. These interactions can gradually lead to friendships and a stronger community.

‏In my opinion, I believe that the social experience of living in a high-rise apartment mainly depends on the individual. The building itself can provide opportunities for social interaction, but residents need to make an effort to communicate with others. If people are friendly and willing to talk to their neighbours, they are more likely to develop good relationships. However, those who prefer privacy may still feel isolated even when they live close to many people.

‏In conclusion, living in a high-rise apartment can sometimes be a lonely experience, but it can also help people develop a strong sense of community. I believe that the way people interact with their neighbours is more important than the type of housing they live in.
